sbi_holdings.ripple_equity: SBI Holdings' June 9 2025 release said it had invested in Ripple since 2016 and held approximately 9% as an external largest shareholder; current November 2026 percentage not independently refreshed.
sbi_holdings.ripple_asia: SBI identifies SBI Ripple Asia as a joint venture with Ripple for payments infrastructure in Japan and Asia.
sbi_holdings.circle_equity: SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank disclosed $50M of Circle equity, split $25M each, in June 2025.
sbi_holdings.circle_jv: SBI and Circle Holdings established a joint venture in August 2025 to promote USDC use and new Japanese use cases.
sbi_holdings.arc: Circle's September 2026 Arc release names SBI Group as a founding validator; SBI says it will use USDC and JPYSC. Arc gas is USDC and the network does not require a volatile native gas token.
sbi_holdings.evernorth: SBI's $200M Evernorth commitment is included within the aggregate $214.05M advance-funding cash pool; do not double count.

sbi_vc_trade_lending.resolution: The direct rendered SBI VC Trade lending page states 29 and lists 29 assets; a search-result snippet says 32. Preserve the discrepancy; use the direct rendered page as primary evidence for this capture.
sbi_vc_trade_lending.historical_usdc_offer: The page describes a USDC 84-day course at 10% annualized for the April 30 2026 solicitation; not a current guaranteed rate.
sbi_vc_trade_lending.distinction: Customers lend assets to SBI VC Trade. This does not establish margin-collateral eligibility, outstanding loan balances, utilization or actual XRP collateral.

circle.usdc_xrpl: Circle announced native USDC on XRPL mainnet on June 12 2025, accessible through Circle Mint/APIs without bridging.
circle.arc: Arc mainnet launched September 16 2026. Circle says SBI Group is a founding validator and Coinbase is among exchange partners; Arc fees are paid in USDC, not a volatile native token.
circle.economics: Circle's October 16 2026 company blog reports H1 2026 USDC onchain volume >$36T, $315B mint/redemption, $819M distribution-partner and transaction costs, and ~77% of stablecoin transaction volume. It identifies Coinbase as its largest/longest-standing partner and quotes Coinbase average USDC held in products at $20B in Q2 2026, up 44% YoY. These are company-reported metrics; Coinbase-specific revenue share is not disclosed.
circle.relationship_to_ripple: Circle and Ripple stablecoins coexist on XRPL; no direct Circle-Ripple commercial partnership is inferred from shared ledger presence.

coinbase.circle: Coinbase took an equity stake in Circle under the 2023 agreement and has an ongoing commercial relationship sharing USDC economics.
coinbase.ripple: Ripple's October 28 2026 announcement made RLUSD available on Coinbase Prime, Exchange and Retail, with XRPL, Base and Ethereum support. Coinbase Global Exchange collateral availability was stated as future at announcement.
coinbase.cbxrp: Coinbase's November 11 proof page displayed 151,709,177.16 XRP reserve against 151,706,930.63 cbXRP supply: 2,246.53 XRP displayed surplus, approximately 0.00148%. Issuer display, not an independent audit or proof of new spot purchases.
coinbase.strategic_position: Coinbase is a multi-issuer distribution, custody and market-access platform with USDC economics, RLUSD distribution, cbXRP custody/wrapping and Arc exchange participation. These alignments do not imply exclusive XRP preference.

institutional_relationships.ripple_prime: Ripple's October 15 2026 release describes 24/7 RWA perpetual swaps across 100+ reference markets, including Virtu, using Trade.xyz contracts on Hyperliquid. Ripple Prime acts as principal and RLUSD may be collateral. No XRP collateral leg is disclosed.
institutional_relationships.bny: BNY's October 27 2026 release says it is primary reserve custodian for RLUSD and now supports XRP and RLUSD custody. Planned direct RLUSD mint/redeem and C2FO tokenized trade-finance work are subject to approvals/exploration. BNY also provides Circle USDC reserve custody and mint/burn services, making it a common institutional custody node, not proof of a direct Circle-Ripple partnership.
institutional_relationships.standard_chartered: Ripple's October 12 2026 release says Standard Chartered custody for RLUSD on XRPL is live through its DIFC branch. Planned RLUSD collateral mirroring with LMAX remains subject to final documentation, testing, laws, internal approvals and jurisdiction readiness; no XRP collateral is disclosed.

capital_taxonomy.actual_capital_definition: 'Actual capital' is not a standardized XRP metric. Keep distinct ledgers for cash received, in-kind XRP, cash used to buy XRP, equity subscriptions, debt, drawn facilities, undrawn ELOC capacity, posted collateral, registered resale and actual secondary sales.

capital_taxonomy.interpretation: Registered resale is not cash to Evernorth or proof of XRP sales. Cantor ELOC capacity is not actual cash unless drawn. SBI/Circle/Ripple equity relationships are not XRP token purchases.

xrpl_governance.status: Native XRPL lending is not active. SingleAssetVault supports XRP, IOU or MPT, so XRP collateral is not mandatory even after activation.
